> Turning a real houseplant into an interactive, living art piece that reacts to touch and monitors its own health using an arduino. When a person touches the plant's leaves, through touch sensor,  it plays musical note resulted from the buzzer. It monitors the hydration of the soil using moisture sensor, which is shown by the leds.
